title: Feature Requirements Brief
description: Example of an agent grilling its user before building a feature: every question ships with a recommended answer as the default. Covers every control type schemaui renders.

feature_name.title: Feature name
feature_name.description: Short identifier used in branches, flags, and changelogs (kebab-case).

one_liner.title: One-liner
one_liner.description: One sentence: who benefits and why now.
one_liner.default: Let workspace admins invite teammates by email so onboarding stops going through support.

target_release.title: Target release
target_release.description: Single-select: which train should this ship on?

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Multi-select: every surface that must ship this feature.

expected_daily_users.title: Expected daily users
expected_daily_users.description: Order-of-magnitude guess; drives whether we need rate limiting.

breaking_change.title: Breaking change
breaking_change.description: Does any existing API or config file change meaning?

breaking_change_notes.title: What breaks
breaking_change_notes.description: Only asked once you flag a breaking change: what breaks, and how do existing users migrate?

owner_email.title: Owner email
owner_email.description: Who approves the rollout and gets paged when it burns.

storage.title: Storage backend
storage.description: Complex composition: pick one variant, then fill only its fields.

cache.title: Cache
cache.description: Nested section: collapses into its own tab group. Turning it off hides the settings it owns.

endpoints.title: API endpoints
endpoints.description: List editor: each entry opens its own overlay form.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Key/value map: free-form tags for dashboards and cost tracking.
